description: Appends a timestamped note to a recruiting candidate's journey (candidate_id, from read the candidate), as Add note on their record does, so the office keeps an inspectable log of calls and conversations. This is not the single overwritable notes field (edit_candidate changes that). Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_candidate_note
title: Add a note to a recruiting candidate
